story.about: One unsolved editing problem becomes a creative system.
story.whyCare: A familiar frustration changes into an unexpected creative possibility.
story.hook: Enter a transformed world and withhold its ordinary paper origin.
story.beginning: One conversation and two drifting sound signals.
story.development: Each fix opens a larger problem.
story.tension: Failed renders and zero capacity stop the route.
story.payoff: The ordinary paper hull and sail become a full vessel in one coherent world.
story.ending: The film names AutoPromote before its layered native identity resolves.
story.withheld: The hook’s source and the film’s production identity.

script.action: Enter the final three seconds of the same transformed vessel, withholding its paper origin.
script.sound: I thought I was fixing one edit.

script.action: A retained moving conversation fills the frame. Two differently timed amber/violet waveform rows align below it.
script.sound: Two cameras. One conversation. They refused to stay together.

script.action: The moving conversation and SYNC / SOUND / RENDER labels are interrupted by a physical dark shutter and a red FAILED lockup.
script.sound: Fix the timing. Lose the sound. Fix the sound. Break the render.

script.action: An archived graphic reconstruction of render errors sits in depth beside the illuminated word AGAIN. This is not an unmodified error screenshot.
script.sound: Some days, the only thing that finished was the error log.

script.action: A large extruded zero on a dark stage with NO CAPACITY. The narration carries the setback; no quota email, archive date or GPU class is shown in this shot.
script.sound: Even the machines said no. But I couldn't leave it there.

script.action: The extruded zero and physical panels move aside to show retained generated yacht footage. 3000 milliGPU labels the historical capacity; this is not a new grant or 3000 physical GPUs.
script.sound: Then one door opened. And the question changed.

script.action: STORY / SHOT / CUT / SOUND labels resolve over the retained conversation, then the retained generated yacht becomes the chosen source. This is an authored concept visualization, not a recording of a live Director plan.
script.sound: What if the system could understand the story? Create the missing shot. Find the cut. Build the sound.

script.action: One continuous folded-paper hull and sail become timber and canvas while the workbench sinks into a deep ocean; the camera follows the same vessel.
script.sound: Bring it together. I didn't know I was building this.

script.action: The created-by sentence resolves on a dark dimensional field, with restrained camera movement. No live Studio UI/project recording is represented.
script.sound: The film you just watched was created by AutoPromote.

script.action: Original exact logo contours emerge as titanium, optical-black, anodized-violet and glass layers; grazing light and a macro-to-lockup camera resolve at 3.2s, followed by a clean static hold.
script.sound: Rise and impact at the identity lockup.

outputs.purpose: An ordinary editing problem grows through setbacks into a creative system; the physical transformation earns the opening image and the created-by reveal.

sequence.reason: Open inside the payoff and create a question about how it was made.
Make sync understandable to a stranger through one human conversation, not interface instructions.
Each fix causes a consequence, building frustration.
Let a setback hurt; hold briefly rather than racing through a decorative code montage.
External constraint becomes the lowest point; persistence is the emotional turn.
A genuine quota grant and bounded execution earn the release of tension. 3000 milliGPU is capacity, not 3000 physical GPUs.
Move from repairs to creative decisions, with real sources and editorial data.
Complete the opening world through connected visible geometry, material and scale change.
Land the promised self-referential payoff. Production receipts disclose assistant-directed story and source generation versus actual AutoPromote editing/rendering.
A dedicated editable brand sequence, not a flat logo fade.

plannedBlackRanges.reason: Dedicated ident dark anticipation before the structural lighting reveal.

outputs.purpose: 26.5-second problem, capacity obstacle, breakthrough, connected transformation and self-referential ending.
